title: Zoni's Mob Friendly Fire
description: Makes it so monsters cannot damage other monsters
body:
[![alt text](https://www.bisecthosting.com/partners/custom-banners/aa8962f9-e6ff-4a83-8eeb-d145d3c55343.webp) ](https://bisecthosting.com/Zoni25)

### No Monster Friendly Fire
Tired of watching mobs defeat themselves before you even get a chance to fight them?

This mod prevents monsters from accidentally (or intentionally) damaging each other during combat. No more skeletons shooting their zombie friends, no more creepers blowing up entire hordes, and no more ghasts disrupting the natural chaos of the Nether!

If you want to get updates on the mod development, report bugs or suggest new stuff or just contact me join my discord server:
https://discord.com/invite/KWGakdBVwG
